name: Current Topics in Ion Channels and Receptors
description: Overview of neuronal physiology; ion channels and receptors of excitable cell membrane; ion channel properties: permeability, selectivity, gating and rectification; Nernst-Planck and Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz equations; classification of ion channels and receptors; structure and function studies of ion channels and receptors: voltage-gated Na+ and K+ channels, ligand-gated acetylcholine receptor channel, mechano-gated mscL and Piezo channels; allosteric modulation of ion channels: theories and application; ion channel and receptor pharmacology; methods to study ion channels and receptors: patch-clamp, planar-bilayer, crystallography and cryo-EM studies; simulation of single channel activity and macroscopic currents from kinetic modeling.
